result.reason: The redline does not reach the preferred position because it does not prohibit Vendor assignment to a Customer competitor, and Section 3(c) remains an unqualified assignment restriction that conflicts with Sparkling’s new affiliate/successor carve-out. It also does not reach the fallback because Vendor lacks a notice-only right to assign to a successor. The margin comment cannot cure these operative defects. The changes are confined to assignment and preserve unrelated commercial terms, but adding corporate-reorganization coverage while leaving the conflicting provision unresolved is not a minimal or professionally complete implementation.
